rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for the physical area around a person or thing.

example.english: Look around the house; flowers are planted everywhere in the surroundings.
example.traditional: 你睇吓間屋周圍，種滿晒花。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa2 gaan1 uk1 zau1 wai4 zung2 mun5 saai3 faa1

rows.note: Choose this when “surroundings” means the overall environment or setting, including its conditions and atmosphere.

example.english: The surroundings at this restaurant are so pleasant that you never feel tired sitting here.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳環境好舒服，坐幾耐都唔覺攰。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 waan4 ging2 hou2 syu1 fuk6 co5 gei2 noi6 dou1 m4 gok3 gui6
